scope: All filesystem mutations confined to TemporaryDirectory mapped boot/modules/proc fixtures
Actual verify_build hashes/config/release validation runs, plus actual filesystem copies, symlinks, backup and config replacement
No subprocesses, network, real root privileges, live boot files or system modules touched
Success preserves all stock boot bytes and exact CRLF backup; correct custom image,DTB,overlay and module links; unchanged idempotent rerun
Foreign config, partial destination/backup/staging/modules, nonPi, wrong rootlayout/platform/privilege/unmountedboot and insufficientspace refuse without changingbootselection
make staging failure, missingstagedmodules anddepmodfailure preservebootselection; incomplete copiedmodules cause safe retryrefusal
Original backup byte-for-byte rollback check; managedprefix beforedtoverlay,automaticinitramfscommenting,globalcmdlinepath retained
Idempotent rerun refuses installed image/DTB/overlay corruption and missing installed modules/dependency index; compressed module filename presence accepted by current guard
limitations: Fixtures do not validate firmware behaviour, kernelboot, actualmodules_install/depmod execution or physicalPi hardware. CI and reader bench verification remain separate.
